requirements.text: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with Web technologies (JS, React, HTML, CSS)
* Experience debugging issues, benchmarking performance, and implementing automated testing
* Experience with programming languages (Javascript, PHP, Python, C++, etc)
* Proven experience translating business requirements into software requirements and explaining the system design
* Experience evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies based on project requirements, trade-offs, and scalability needs
* Knowledge of architectural design for frontend applications and fullstack systems
* 10+ years of experience building software for robotics/enterprise infrastructure
* Experience with fullstack development (Hack/PHP, GraphQL, SQL)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Knowledge of Robotics applications and products towards software development
* Experience working on a global team in a matrixed environment with limited supervision
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience leading and contributing to large cross-functional projects in a global environment
* Knowledge of PHP, Javascript, Python, React, GraphQL
